properties.displayName: Alert Event ASIM filtering parser for Wiz Cloud (WizIssuesV3_CL)
properties.query:
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// EventSubType is derived from issueType: THREAT_DETECTION issues are always
// "Threat". TOXIC_COMBINATION issues are only "Threat" when the rule NAME
// contains a confirmed-exploit/compromise keyword (malware, exfiltration,
// C2, brute force, validated unauthorized access, etc.) as most TOXIC_COMBINATIONS
// are not direct threat signals, but occassional a malware detection is
// classified as TOXIC_COMBINATION vs. a THREAT_DETECTION
//
// This source has no IP address data and no MITRE tactic or technique
// fields, so ipaddr_has_any_prefix, attacktactics_has_any, and
// attacktechniques_has_any are not functional (accepted for imAlertEvent
// compatibility only). username_has_any filters on identity-typed entities
// (USER_ACCOUNT/SERVICE_ACCOUNT) only. AlertVerdict is also unsupported.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
let ThreatKeywordRegex = @'(?i)(malware|ransomware|phishing|spyware|rootkit|adware|trojan|worm|infected|exploit|unauthorized access|backdoor|\bc2\b|command and control|crypto.?min|cryptojack|exfiltrat|compromis|botnet|keylog|brute force|reverse shell|web ?shell)';
// ASIM's Hostname logical type is a single DNS label, Regex matches ASIMs data tester
// Wiz primaryResource.name for some VM/container entities holds
// an ARM resource ID, a multi-label FQDN (e.g. AWS EC2 internal DNS names), a VMSS
// instance ID with underscores (e.g. "aks-apps2-16464496-vmss_6"), or other
let HostnameFormatRegex = @'^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$';
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    hostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    attacktactics_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    attacktechniques_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    threatcategory_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    alertverdict_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventseverity_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    WizIssuesV3_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
            and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | extend
        _RuleName = tostring(sourceRule.name),
        _RuleDescription = tostring(sourceRule.description),
        _EntityName = tostring(entitySnapshot.name),
        _EntityType = tostring(entitySnapshot.type)
    | extend
        _IsIdentityEntity = _EntityType in ("USER_ACCOUNT", "SERVICE_ACCOUNT"),
        _IsHostEntity = _EntityType in ("VIRTUAL_MACHINE", "CONTAINER", "DB_SERVER")
    | where array_length(eventseverity_has_any) == 0 or (
        ("High" in (eventseverity_has_any) and severity in ("HIGH", "CRITICAL"))
        or ("Medium" in (eventseverity_has_any) and severity == "MEDIUM")
        or ("Low" in (eventseverity_has_any) and severity == "LOW")
        or ("Informational" in (eventseverity_has_any) and severity == "INFORMATIONAL")
    )
    | where array_length(alertverdict_has_any) == 0 // Source does not support AlertVerdict
    | where array_length(attacktactics_has_any) == 0 // Source has no MITRE tactic data
    | where array_length(attacktechniques_has_any) == 0 // Source has no MITRE technique data
    | where array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or (_IsIdentityEntity and _EntityName has_any (username_has_any))
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 // Source has no actor/IP data
    | where array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0 or (
        _IsHostEntity
        and _EntityName has_any (hostname_has_any)
    )
    | extend
        _RuleId = tostring(sourceRule.id),
        _RuleResolution = tostring(sourceRule.resolutionRecommendation),
        _RuleSourceType = tostring(sourceRule.sourceType),
        _EntityId = tostring(entitySnapshot.id),
        _EntityNativeType = tostring(entitySnapshot.nativeType),
        _EntityExternalId = tostring(entitySnapshot.externalId),
        _EntityProviderId = tostring(entitySnapshot.providerId),
        _EntityCloudPlatform = tostring(entitySnapshot.cloudPlatform),
        _EntitySubscriptionExtId = tostring(entitySnapshot.subscriptionExternalId),
        _EntitySubscriptionName = tostring(entitySnapshot.subscriptionName)
    | extend
        _IsAzureArmId = _EntityCloudPlatform == "Azure" and _EntityExternalId matches regex @'(?i)^/subscriptions/',
        _IsThreatKeywordMatch = _RuleName matches regex ThreatKeywordRegex
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(createdAt, TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(resolvedAt, updatedAt, TimeGenerated),
        EventCount = toint(1),
        EventType = "Alert",
        EventSubType = case(
            issueType == "THREAT_DETECTION", "Threat",
            issueType == "TOXIC_COMBINATION" and _IsThreatKeywordMatch, "Threat",
            "Compliance Violation"
        ),
        EventProduct = "Cloud",
        EventVendor = "Wiz",
        EventSchema = "AlertEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1",
        EventUid = issueId,
        EventOriginalUid = issueId,
        EventOriginalType = issueType,
        EventOriginalSubType = _RuleSourceType,
        EventOriginalSeverity = severity,
        EventSeverity = case(
            severity == "CRITICAL", "High",
            severity == "HIGH", "High",
            severity == "MEDIUM", "Medium",
            severity == "LOW", "Low",
            severity == "INFORMATIONAL", "Informational",
            "Informational"
        ),
        // WizIssuesV3_CL has no success/failure outcome concept
        EventResult = "NA",
        EventMessage = iff(isnotempty(_RuleDescription), _RuleDescription, _RuleName),
        EventReportUrl = sourceURL,
        Url = sourceURL,
        AlertName = _RuleName,
        AlertOriginalStatus = status,
        AlertStatus = case(
            status in ("OPEN", "IN_PROGRESS"), "Active",
            status in ("REJECTED", "RESOLVED"), "Closed",
            ""
        )
    | extend
        ThreatCategory = case(
            _RuleName has "malware", "Malware",
            _RuleName has "ransomware", "Ransomware",
            _RuleName has "phishing", "Phishing",
            _RuleName has "spyware", "Spyware",
            _RuleName has "rootkit", "Rootkit",
            _RuleName has "adware", "Adware",
            _RuleName has "trojan", "Trojan",
            _RuleName has "worm", "Worm",
            _RuleName has "cryptocurrency" or _RuleName has "cryptomin", "Cryptominer",
            EventSubType == "Compliance Violation", "Security Policy Violation",
            "Unknown"
        )
    | where array_length(threatcategory_has_any) == 0 or ThreatCategory in (threatcategory_has_any)
    | extend
        RuleName = _RuleId,
        RuleDescription = _RuleDescription,
        AttackRemediationSteps = _RuleResolution,
        DetectionMethod = "Cloud Security Posture Management",
        DvcId = iff(_IsIdentityEntity, "", coalesce(_EntityExternalId, _EntityProviderId, _EntityId)),
        DvcIdType = iff(_IsIdentityEntity, "", iff(_IsAzureArmId, "AzureResourceId", "Other")),
        DvcScopeId = iff(_IsIdentityEntity, "", _EntitySubscriptionExtId),
        DvcScope = iff(_IsIdentityEntity, "", _EntitySubscriptionName),
        DvcHostname = iff(_IsHostEntity and _EntityName matches regex HostnameFormatRegex, _EntityName, ""),
        Username = iff(_IsIdentityEntity, _EntityName, ""),
        UserId = iff(_IsIdentityEntity, coalesce(_EntityExternalId, _EntityProviderId, _EntityId), "")
    | extend
        UserIdType = case(
            isempty(UserId), "",
            UserId startswith "arn:", "AWSId",
            "Other"
        ),
        UserType = case(
            _EntityType == "SERVICE_ACCOUNT", "Service Principal",
            _EntityType == "USER_ACCOUNT", "Regular",
            ""
        ),
        OriginalUserType = iff(_IsIdentityEntity, _EntityNativeType, ""),
        IndicatorType = case(
            _IsIdentityEntity, "User",
            _IsHostEntity, "Host",
            isnotempty(_EntityId) or isnotempty(_EntityExternalId), "Cloud Resource",
            ""
        )
    | extend
        UsernameType = case(
            isempty(Username), "",
            Username has "@", "UPN",
            "Simple"
        ),
        ThreatFirstReportedTime = EventStartTime,
        ThreatLastReportedTime = EventEndTime,
        AlertId = EventUid,
        AlertDescription = EventMessage,
        Rule = RuleName,
        Hostname = DvcHostname,
        User = Username,
        Dvc = case(
            isnotempty(DvcId), DvcId,
            isnotempty(DvcHostname), DvcHostname,
            EventProduct
        )
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack,
            pack(
                "SourceRule", sourceRule,
                "EntitySnapshot", entitySnapshot,
                "Evidence", evidence,
                "DueAt", dueAt,
                "StatusChangedAt", statusChangedAt,
                "ServiceTickets", serviceTickets,
                "Projects", projects,
                "Notes", notes
            ),
            dynamic(null)
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventStartTime,
        EventEndTime,
        EventCount,
        EventType,
        EventSubType,
        EventResult,
        EventSeverity,
        EventOriginalSeverity,
        EventProduct,
        EventVendor,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        EventUid,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalSubType,
        EventMessage,
        EventReportUrl,
        Url,
        AlertName,
        AlertId,
        AlertDescription,
        AlertOriginalStatus,
        AlertStatus,
        ThreatCategory,
        ThreatFirstReportedTime,
        ThreatLastReportedTime,
        RuleName,
        RuleDescription,
        Rule,
        AttackRemediationSteps,
        DetectionMethod,
        Username,
        UsernameType,
        UserId,
        UserIdType,
        UserType,
        OriginalUserType,
        User,
        DvcId,
        DvcHostname,
        DvcIdType,
        DvcScopeId,
        DvcScope,
        Dvc,
        Hostname,
        IndicatorType,
        AdditionalFields,
        Type
};
parser(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    hostname_has_any=hostname_has_any,
    username_has_any=username_has_any,
    attacktactics_has_any=attacktactics_has_any,
    attacktechniques_has_any=attacktechniques_has_any,
    threatcategory_has_any=threatcategory_has_any,
    alertverdict_has_any=alertverdict_has_any,
    eventseverity_has_any=eventseverity_has_any,
    disabled=disabled,
    pack=pack
)
